method: flux depth in a terrestrial-only band against a clean control, same metric as RYA-805 (pct_below_0.5)

discriminator.reads: flux reaches 0.006 inside the O2 A-band while never dropping below 0.1796 in a clean window 60 A away

consequence: None for the HARPS band products. `harps` is registered telluric_required=no, so gate_holding() permits it and tellurics are handled by per-line clean-line selection over the enumerated bands (RYA-460/786) — which is what quarantined the 5 O2 B-band lines in the RYA-897 run, with the reason stated. This records the state; it does not change the method.
